User: how do i find iron early in minecraft

Your first iron should usually go into a shield and pickaxe because they increase survival and progression speed. User: how do i find diamonds in minecraft
Assistant: To find diamonds, follow this order: 1) bring an iron pickaxe, food, torches, and a water bucket. 2) mine at strong diamond levels. 3) use branch mining or explore deep caves carefully. 4) block lava flows before mining exposed ore. 5) save diamonds for key tools first. A water bucket makes deep mining much safer because it controls lava and prevents fall damage. Do not stand directly on top of a diamond vein and break the block under yourself into lava.

User: how do i explore caves safely in minecraft
Assistant: To explore caves safely, follow this order: 1) bring blocks, torches, food, a shield, and water. 2) light branches as you enter them. 3) block dangerous openings when needed. 4) retreat to heal instead of forcing every fight. 5) mark your exit path clearly. Controlled cave exploration is faster than reckless rushing because you lose less gear and time. Do not drop into dark vertical spaces without checking for mobs or lava first.

User: how do i build a mob farm in minecraft
Assistant: To build a mob farm, follow this order: 1) build high enough or spawn-proof the surrounding area. 2) create dark spawning platforms. 3) move mobs into a kill chamber. 4) collect drops safely. 5) light caves nearby if rates are poor. Spawn-proofing outside the farm often matters as much as the farm itself. If nearby caves are unlit, your farm can feel much slower than expected.

Consistent muscle memory matters more than one flashy successful clutch. Waiting too long to swap to the bucket is the usual reason clutches fail.

User: how do i bridge safely in minecraft

User: how do i learn redstone basics in minecraft
Assistant: To learn redstone basics, follow this order: 1) learn how power travels through dust. 2) practice with levers, buttons, pistons, and repeaters. 3) build one small mechanism at a time. 4) test each section before combining them. 5) label or separate parts if the circuit gets messy. Redstone gets easier once you stop trying to build everything as one giant first attempt. Debugging is much harder when you skip small tests and wire the whole build at once.

User: how do i ask solasai something in minecraft
Assistant: Use /solasai ask <prompt> or /askai <prompt>. The mod sends your prompt to the backend and posts the reply back into chat.
User: how do i change the solasai backend
Assistant: Use /solasai backend <url>. The client stores the endpoint and sends future chat and mc-agent requests there.
User: how do i check the solasai backend url
Assistant: Use /solasai backend with no extra argument. It prints the current configured backend endpoint.
User: how do i see the current ai task
Assistant: Use /solasai task or /solasai tas. The client shows the current task text from the controller.
User: how do i check the stronghold estimate
Assistant: Use /solasai stronghold. If the mod has triangulated enough eye throws, it will print the estimated stronghold coordinates.
User: can solasai read chat
Assistant: Yes. The Fabric client registers a chat receive event and can react to incoming chat lines when auto-reply is enabled.
User: can solasai send chat messages
Assistant: Yes. The client can send normal chat through the player network handler and can also issue slash commands when needed.
User: how do i toggle the ai overlay
Assistant: Press F3 plus Tab. The mod toggles the debug overlay and prints whether the overlay is now on or off.
User: how do i start ai control
Assistant: Press Ctrl plus Tab while in game with no screen open. That opens the SolasAI prompt screen so you can start the controller with an objective.
User: how do i stop ai control
Assistant: Press Escape or Escape plus Tab while the AI is active. The controller stops and releases movement inputs.
User: what does ai join do
Assistant: AI Join connects to a multiplayer server with an objective and starts the controller once the world loads.
User: what does solasai bases do
Assistant: The /solasai bases command asks the bot service for saved base candidates on the current server and prints them in chat.
User: can the mod run swarms
Assistant: Yes. The client can send a swarm start request to the bot service with count, username mode, jobs, and auto-think settings.
User: does solasai use chat history
Assistant: For chat replies, the backend keeps short session context so responses can stay consistent across recent messages.
User: can solasai read minecraft state
Assistant: Yes. The mc-agent endpoint receives a game state snapshot including health, food, enemies, and other context for decision making.
User: how do i make chat replies trigger
Assistant: Mention solasai in chat when auto-reply is enabled or use the ask commands directly if you want a forced backend reply.
User: can solasai send slash commands
Assistant: Yes. The controller already uses sendChatCommand when possible and falls back to a slash-prefixed chat message if needed.
